subject: [PATCH v3 6/8] fs: check a fine-grained time before clamping a delegated ctime

2026-11-09.patch_summary: This patch modifies the inode_set_ctime_deleg function to check a fine-grained time before clamping an update to a delegated ctime. This prevents updates that are past the coarse time but within the same tick as the last reported fine-grained ctime from being clamped back in time, which can cause issues with timestamp delegations. The patch also raises the floor of the update to at least the update itself, ensuring that later coarse stamps cannot land before it. This change affects both multigrain and non-multigrain filesystems.
